gloss: freshly baked; just out of the oven

definitions.gloss: freshly baked; just grilled; hot out of the oven
definitions.explanation: describes baked or grilled food that has just been cooked and is still hot

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{立|た}てのクロワッサンを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a freshly baked croissant.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{立|た}てのパンの{香|かお}りがたまらない。
examples.english: The smell of freshly baked bread is irresistible.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{焼|や}き{立|た}てのピザを{提供|ていきょう}している。
examples.english: This restaurant serves freshly baked pizza.

notes:
FORMATION:
{焼|や}く (to bake, grill) + {立|た}て (just after ~ing) → just after baking

FUNCTIONS AS:
- Noun: {焼|や}き{立|た}てがおいしい (freshly baked is delicious)
- No-adjective: {焼|や}き{立|た}てのパン (freshly baked bread)

COMMON USES:
- {焼|や}き{立|た}てパン (freshly baked bread)
- {焼|や}き{立|た}てクッキー (freshly baked cookies)
- {焼|や}き{立|た}て{肉|にく} (freshly grilled meat)
- {焼|や}き{立|た}て{焼|や}き{鳥|とり} (freshly grilled yakitori)

RELATED ～{立|た}て WORDS:
- {出来立|できた}て (freshly made - general)
- {揚|あ}げ{立|た}て (freshly fried)
- {炊|た}き{立|た}て (freshly cooked rice)

POPULAR CULTURE:
{焼|や}きたて!!ジャぱん (Yakitate!! Japan) is a famous manga/anime about bread-making that popularized the term.
